messages:
jordan: Quick roundup from the PM: we need concrete owners for the canary follow-ups (auto-rollback, flag defaults, blast-radius caps, telemetry for ramp regressions). Who can take what?
elaine: Ian drive flag defaults + the CLI change to enforce min-scope on new flags. Plan: default min_percent=1, safety_max=20, and an opt-out with engineering approval. Draft RFC by Tue.
ravi: Ian pick up auto-rollback knobs. Will prototype two modes: soft (alert + hold rollout) and hard (immediate rollback) with backoff. Will test in staging with fault injection.
tess: I
gree on telemetry. I'll add canary regression fingerprints to our alert pipeline so we can surface recurring failure clusters. Also adding a dashboard for per-flag health during ramps.
jordan: Add tickets and link them here. Also include required infra perms if you need scheduler or controller changes.
ops-bot: Incident reminder: linked postmortem RD-4520.
elaine: RFC opened: https://go/redwood/rfcs/flag-scope-defaults (draft). Highlights: enforce staged ramps and require a rollout_template for flags that touch routing.
ravi: Prototype config I pushed to staging (build #4582). Sketch:
```
rollback:
  mode: hard
  trigger: cpu_spike OR error_rate > 4% (rolling 1m)
  cooldown: 10m
```
Please review.
tess: Dashboard PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/telemetry/pull/204. Adds canary view + regression clustering.
jordan: Timeline check: elaien RFC Tue, ravi prototype Wed, tess dashboard Wed as well. Can we validate by Friday with an injected error run?
elaine: I'll coordinate the validation window and add runbook steps for safe rollback verification.
ravi: Scheduling a 20-min chaos run on Thu 10:00 UTC to exercise rollback paths. Will invite oncall.
ops-bot: Deployment: canary-rollback-proto -> staging (deployer: ravi, build: 4582).
jordan: Good. Add any blockers here. If infra needs permission changes, tag @infra. We'll reconvene after the validation run to accept or iterate on defaults.
__meta: generated for dataset: postmortem follow-ups and action tracking
